description: Saves and publishes an app's waiting changes, in pro (the published app the users have) or pre (its private test copy). File and setting changes wait in a draft per environment, and app-wide actions (who opens pre, keys, slug, domain, invitations) in one app queue. "save" applies that env's draft and the queue: env "pro" reaches the users at once, "pre" only the testers, no env saves pre, never pro. "promote" copies what pre has saved to pro, live at once; "rollback" puts an earlier release back in pro at once; "discard" deletes that env's draft and the queue (irreversible). Not for the gallery listing (neblla_publish_app). More: neblla_get_llms tools/promote

action.description: "save", "discard", "promote" (pre to pro) or "rollback". By action: save {env}; rollback {releaseId}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

confirm.description: discard: true runs it; without it nothing changes and the answer says what would be lost.

confirmEmpty.description: save / promote / rollback: accept a version with no files replacing one that has files.

confirmRoomsChange.description: save / promote / rollback: accept losing room data saved in pro (else error rooms_data_loss).

env.description: save / discard: "pro" or "pre". save with no env saves pre, never pro; discard with no env: the environment picked in the panel (workEnv in status).

releaseId.description: For rollback: the version's id, from neblla_promote_read releases.

scope.description: discard: "unsaved" (default) the draft only; "all" (env "pre" only) also resets pre to what pro has.

name: neblla_promote
title: Publish changes
